permissions._comment_qa_commands: The `manage.py` entries in the allow list are dev-database-only QA commands. danger_content_delete clears content inside the per-branch dev database and is strictly less destructive than dev_db_delete.sh, which drops that database outright and is already prompt-free via the scripts wildcard. migrate is deliberately excluded: a destructive migration is the one command here that can cost work someone wanted to keep.
permissions._comment_qa_scripts: Any script placed in .claude/ds/scripts/ or .claude/fls-dev/scripts/ is thereby granted prompt-free QA execution with arbitrary arguments via the Bash(.claude/<plugin>/scripts/*.sh:*) wildcards (in both the direct and `bash <script>` invocation forms), and must be reviewed as security-sensitive — equivalent to adding an allow-list entry.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "${f##*/}" in .env.example) ;; .env|.env.*) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Reading .env secret files is blocked; only .env.example may be read."}}' ;; esac
